title: SAP Fiori: qué es y arquitectura
excerpt: Introducción a Fiori y sus componentes.
body:
## SAP Fiori
UX framework de SAP:
- Consistent look & feel across SAP apps
- Responsive (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- Role-based
- Business-focused

## Componentes

### SAPUI5 (framework)
JavaScript library open-source (variant of OpenUI5) para construir apps.

### Fiori design guidelines
Spec de UX (colors, typography, spacing, patterns).

### Fiori launchpad (FLP)
Entry point con tiles.

### Fiori apps
Apps que siguen guidelines. Categorías:
- **Transactional** — data entry/change
- **Analytical** — dashboards
- **Fact sheets** — 360° view of entity
- **Search** — enterprise search

### SAP Business Application Studio
IDE cloud para dev Fiori.

## Fiori Elements
Meta-driven UI:
- Templates: List Report, Object Page, Analytical List Page, Overview Page
- Derive UI from OData annotations
- Menos código para common patterns

### Ejemplo
Annotate OData entity:
```json
{
    'UI.LineItem': [
        { 'Value': 'ProductName' },
        { 'Value': 'Price' }
    ],
    'UI.HeaderInfo': {
        'Title': { 'Value': 'ProductName' }
    }
}
```

Fiori Elements template renders List Report + Object Page automatic.

## Deploy scenarios

### On-premise
- ABAP Web Dynpro (obsoleto)
- SAP Gateway (OData + Fiori launchpad)
- FLP en NetWeaver 7.5+

### S/4HANA
Fiori native. Every transaction migrating.

### Cloud
- SAP BTP HTML5 Application Repository
- BTP Work Zone
- Fiori launchpad en cloud

## Fiori version
- **Fiori 3** (current) — modern design
- **Fiori 2** — 2016 refresh
- **Fiori 1** — original (2013)

## Access
Usuarios acceden via:
- Fiori launchpad URL
- Bookmark direct app
- Mobile (SAP Mobile Start)

## Development flow
1. Design app (Fiori guidelines)
2. Build UI (SAPUI5 + Fiori Elements)
3. Backend OData service
4. Deploy to launchpad
5. Assign to roles

## Common terms
- **Component** — self-contained UI unit
- **View** — screen definition (XML)
- **Controller** — logic (JavaScript)
- **Model** — data (OData, JSON)
- **Manifest.json** — app metadata

## Resources
- https://openui5.org — framework
- https://experience.sap.com/fiori-design-web/ — design guidelines
- https://sapui5.hana.ondemand.com/ — SAPUI5 API docs
- Fiori Launchpad Content Manager (fla) — publish apps

title: SAP Fiori: crear app con SAP Business Application Studio
excerpt: Crear Fiori app desde BAS con templates.
body:
## Prerequisites
- SAP BAS subscription
- Dev space tipo 'SAP Fiori'
- BTP subaccount con XSUAA + HTML5 App Repo

## Crear app
1. BAS command palette → **Create Project from Template**
2. Choose **SAP Fiori application**
3. Template:
   - **List Report Object Page** — CRUD estándar
   - **Overview Page** — dashboard tiles
   - **Analytical List Page** — analytics + list
   - **Worklist** — task list
   - **Freestyle** — from scratch
4. Data source:
   - **Local** — mock data (JSON)
   - **BTP Destination** — remote OData
   - **Direct URL**

## Config
Wizard asks:
- App ID (namespace like `com.empresa.miapp`)
- Description
- Fiori launchpad target (semantic object + action)
- Deployment (CF, ABAP)

## Estructura generada
```
webapp/
  Component.js         # entry point
  manifest.json        # metadata
  view/
    App.view.xml       # main view
    Main.view.xml      # list report view
  controller/
    App.controller.js
    Main.controller.js
  i18n/
    i18n.properties    # translations
  model/
    models.js          # data models
test/
util/
readme.md
package.json
ui5.yaml
```

## Run local
```bash
cd my-app
npm install
npm start
```

Opens en built-in preview (BAS embedded browser). URL: `http://localhost:8080/index.html`

## Preview con data
Data source local → mock data en `webapp/localService/`.
BTP destination → real data via SCC si aplica.

## Deploy
### Option 1: CF (via MTA)
```bash
mbt build
cf deploy mta_archives/*.mtar
```

### Option 2: ABAP repository
Deploy directly to backend ABAP (Netweaver o S/4HANA):
```bash
npx fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml
```

## Fiori Elements vs Freestyle
### Fiori Elements
- Derive UI from OData annotations
- Less code
- Consistent look
- Fast to build for standard CRUD

### Freestyle
- Full control con SAPUI5 controls
- Custom logic
- More code
- Necessary para non-standard UI

## Common errors
- **Metadata not loaded** — OData endpoint no responde
- **Route not found** — manifest routing config wrong
- **Component not created** — Component.js syntax error

## Next steps
- Customize UI
- Add controllers logic
- Configure Fiori launchpad tile
- Set up CI/CD

title: SAP Fiori: XML views y controllers
excerpt: Estructura de views y controllers en SAPUI5.
body:
## Views SAPUI5 supports: - **XML** (recommended) - **JSON** - **JavaScript** - **HTML** XML most common (declarative, tooling support). ## Ejemplo view XML ```xml
``` ## Controller (JavaScript) ```javascript sap.ui.define([ 'sap/ui/core/mvc/Controller', 'sap/ui/model/json/JSONModel' ], function(Controller, JSONModel) { 'use strict'; return Controller.extend('com.empresa.miapp.controller.Main', { onInit: function() { // Runs when view instantiates var oModel = new JSONModel({ Products: [] }); this.getView().setModel(oModel); }, onNavBack: function() { window.history.go(-1); }, onItemPress: function(oEvent) { var oContext = oEvent.getSource().getBindingContext(); var productId = oContext.getProperty('ID'); this.getOwnerComponent().getRouter().navTo('detail', { id: productId }); } }); }); ``` ## Data binding ### Property binding ```xml ``` ### Aggregation binding ```xml
``` ### Expression binding ```xml ``` ### Composite binding ```xml ``` ## Formatter ```javascript formatter: { combine: function(name, category) { return name + ' (' + category + ')'; } } ``` ## Events Controller methods invoked from view: - `onInit` — view instantiation - `onExit` — cleanup - Custom: `onItemPress`, `onSave`, etc. ## Lifecycle - `onInit` — before rendering - `onBeforeRendering` - `onAfterRendering` - `onExit` ## Fragmentos (fragments) Reusable UI pieces: ```xml ``` Loaded en controller: ```javascript sap.ui.core.Fragment.load({ name: 'com.empresa.miapp.view.MyDialog', controller: this }).then(function(oDialog) { oDialog.open(); }); ``` ## Navigation ```javascript this.getOwnerComponent().getRouter().navTo('detail', { id: 123 }); ``` Corresponds to route pattern `detail/{id}` en manifest. ## Best practices - **1 controller per view** (simple) - **Formatters** in separate file - **Constants** in Configuration model - **No hardcoded strings** — use i18n - **Handle errors** en catch blocks

title: SAP Fiori Elements: List Report Object Page
tags: fiori elements, list report, object page, annotations
excerpt: Template más común de Fiori Elements — LROP.
body:
## List Report Object Page (LROP)
Combina:
- **List Report** — table de items con filters
- **Object Page** — detail view de item selected

Usado para CRUD masivo.

## Create con BAS
Template wizard → **List Report Object Page**.

## OData annotations
Drive UI without coding — annotations tell Fiori Elements what/how to show.

### En backend service (CDS or ABAP)
```cds
annotate CatalogService.Products with @(
    UI: {
        LineItem: [
            { Value: name },
            { Value: price },
            { Value: category }
        ],
        HeaderInfo: {
            TypeName: 'Product',
            TypeNamePlural: 'Products',
            Title: { Value: name },
            Description: { Value: category }
        },
        Identification: [
            { Value: name },
            { Value: price }
        ],
        SelectionFields: [ category, price ]
    }
);
```

## UI generated
### List Report page
- Filter bar (based on `SelectionFields`)
- Table (columns from `LineItem`)
- Search field
- Variant management
- Sort, group, filter
- Row selection
- Actions (Create, Edit, Delete)

### Object Page
- Header (from `HeaderInfo`)
- Sections (grouped fields)
- Related entities (tabs)
- Actions (Save, Cancel, custom)

## Add facets (sections en Object Page)
```cds
annotate CatalogService.Products with @(
    UI.Facets: [
        { $Type: 'UI.ReferenceFacet', ID: 'GeneralInfo', Label: 'General', Target: '@UI.FieldGroup#Main' },
        { $Type: 'UI.ReferenceFacet', ID: 'Details', Label: 'Details', Target: '@UI.FieldGroup#Detail' }
    ],
    UI.FieldGroup #Main: {
        Data: [ { Value: name }, { Value: price } ]
    },
    UI.FieldGroup #Detail: {
        Data: [ { Value: description }, { Value: stock } ]
    }
);
```

## Semantic key
Determine which field is unique identifier:
```cds
annotate CatalogService.Products with {
    ID @Common.SemanticObject: 'Product';
};
```

## Actions
### Standard
- Create
- Edit
- Delete
- Save
- Cancel

### Custom actions
```cds
action complete() returns String;
```

With annotation:
```cds
annotate CatalogService.Products with @UI.LineItem: [
    { $Type: 'UI.DataFieldForAction', Label: 'Complete', Action: 'CatalogService.complete' }
];
```

Button appears en toolbar.

## Variants
Users can save filter combos as variants:
- Public variants (admin)
- Private variants (user)

## Draft handling
Optimistic locking + auto-save:
- Edit → creates draft
- Auto-save every N seconds
- Discard or Activate (save)

## Extensibility
Add custom sections, columns via extension API:
```javascript
sap.ui.controller('com.empresa.ext.Extension', {
    onInit: function() { ... }
});
```

Más allá — freestyle preferred.

## Common issues
- **No data shown** — check OData $filter
- **Actions not visible** — annotation typo
- **Column missing** — LineItem missing entry

title: SAP Fiori: i18n (internationalization)
body:
## i18n structure
Recursos en `webapp/i18n/i18n.properties`.

### Default file (English usually)
```properties
# webapp/i18n/i18n.properties
title=My Application
saveButton=Save
cancelButton=Cancel
welcomeMsg=Welcome, {0}!
```

### Locale-specific
```properties
# webapp/i18n/i18n_es.properties (Spanish)
title=Mi Aplicación
saveButton=Guardar
cancelButton=Cancelar
welcomeMsg=Bienvenido, {0}!
```

```properties
# webapp/i18n/i18n_de.properties (German)
title=Meine Anwendung
saveButton=Speichern
...
```

## Load en manifest.json
```json
'sap.app': {
    'i18n': 'i18n/i18n.properties'
},
'sap.ui5': {
    'models': {
        'i18n': {
            'type': 'sap.ui.model.resource.ResourceModel',
            'settings': { 'bundleName': 'com.empresa.miapp.i18n.i18n' }
        }
    }
}
```

## Uso en view
```xml
<Text text='{i18n>title}'/>
<Button text='{i18n>saveButton}' press='.onSave'/>
```

## Uso en controller
```javascript
var oBundle = this.getView().getModel('i18n').getResourceBundle();
var sMessage = oBundle.getText('welcomeMsg', ['Juan']);
// Returns 'Welcome, Juan!' (or localized)
```

## Language detection
UI5 selects based on:
1. URL parameter `sap-language=es`
2. Browser Accept-Language header
3. Default (usually en_US)

## Force language
```javascript
sap.ui.getCore().getConfiguration().setLanguage('es');
// May require app restart
```

## RTL languages
Arabic, Hebrew:
```javascript
sap.ui.getCore().getConfiguration().setRTL(true);
```

CSS auto-mirrors layout.

## Placeholders
```properties
greeting=Hello {0}, you have {1} messages
```

```javascript
oBundle.getText('greeting', ['Juan', 5]);
// 'Hello Juan, you have 5 messages'
```

## Fallback chain
User locale `es_CO`:
1. Look for `i18n_es_CO.properties` — not found
2. Fall back to `i18n_es.properties` — found, use
3. If not, fall back to `i18n.properties`

## Translation tools

### SAP Translation Hub (BTP service)
AI-assisted translation of i18n files.

### Manual
Export English properties → translators → import back.

## Best practices
- **All user-facing text** en i18n
- **NO hardcode strings**
- **Consistent keys** — `button.save`, `error.dbConnection`
- **Support at least English + primary business language**
- **Test each locale** — layout may break with long translations

## Common issues
- **Text shows as key** — missing en resource bundle
- **Wrong language** — locale detection issue
- **Special chars broken** — encoding issue (should be UTF-8)

title: SAP Fiori: table controls (sap.m.Table, sap.ui.table)
body:
## sap.m.Table (Responsive Table) - Mobile-first design - Adapts columns to screen size - Simpler API - Recommended default ### Uso ```xml
``` ### Responsive behavior En tablet/mobile, columns can collapse: ```xml ``` ### Growing - **growing='true'** — infinite scroll - **growingThreshold** — items per page ## sap.ui.table.Table (Grid Table) - Desktop-focused - More features (fixed columns, cell edit) - No mobile responsive - Best for data-dense apps ### Uso ```xml ``` ## Selection ### Modes - **None** - **SingleSelectMaster** — one row selected (highlighted) - **MultiSelect** — checkboxes - **SingleSelect** — radio buttons ### API ```javascript var oTable = this.byId('myTable'); var aSelected = oTable.getSelectedItems(); ``` ## Sorting ```javascript // Programmatic var oBinding = this.byId('myTable').getBinding('items'); oBinding.sort([new Sorter('Name', /* descending */ false)]); ``` Or enable UI: - Column headers clickable when sortable annotations set ## Filtering ```javascript var aFilters = [new Filter('Category', FilterOperator.EQ, 'Electronics')]; var oBinding = this.byId('myTable').getBinding('items'); oBinding.filter(aFilters); ``` ## Grouping ```javascript var oBinding = this.byId('myTable').getBinding('items'); oBinding.sort([new Sorter('Category', false, true)]); // 3rd param = group ``` ## Cell edit (inline) ```xml ``` Changes tracked automatically via 2-way binding. ## Growing threshold + performance Large tables (10k+ rows): - Use sap.ui.table for virtual scrolling - Or server-side paging con OData `$top`/`$skip` ## Custom actions per row ```xml

SAP Fiori: launchpad tiles y grouping
excerpt: Organizar apps en tiles y groups en el launchpad.
body:
## Tiles
Entry points visuales en el launchpad:
- **Static tile** — title + icon + link
- **Dynamic tile** — con KPI (numbers, chart)
- **News tile** — news feed
- **Custom tile** — freestyle

## Create tile
Fiori Launchpad Designer (`/UI2/FLPD_CUST`):
1. **New tile**
2. Choose type
3. Config:
   - Title
   - Subtitle
   - Icon (SAP-icon library)
   - Semantic object + action (intent for navigation)

## Dynamic tile
Subscribed to OData service that returns KPI:

```
GET /sap/opu/odata/sap/API/CountOrders?$count
```

Response count → displayed en tile.

### Config
- Service URL
- Refresh interval (seconds)
- Number formatter
- Info text (subtitle dynamically updated)

## Catalog
Group de tiles logically:
- **Sales Catalog**
- **Finance Catalog**
- **HR Catalog**

Users see catalogs relevant to their role.

## Group
User's personal grouping. Default groups + custom.

Users pin tiles to their groups.

## Role mapping
- Catalog assigned to business role (PFCG role)
- Users have role → see catalog → tiles available to pin

## Personalization
User can:
- Move tiles between groups
- Delete/hide tiles
- Custom app search
- Save layouts

Admin can lock personalization if needed.

## Custom tile con SAPUI5
Developer can create custom tile via component:
- Extend `sap.ushell.ui.tile.TileBase`
- Render custom content (chart, complex)
- Register en launchpad

## Design
- **Icon** — from SAP icon library (~1000+ icons)
- **Color** — semantic (Good, Neutral, Critical, Error, informative)
- **Number format** — thousand separators, currency

## Semantic navigation
Click tile → navigate to app via intent (semantic object + action).

## App Finder
Users can search all available apps in catalog:
- **Fiori launchpad → App Finder**
- Search / browse / pin to group

## Common issues
- **Tile not visible** — role not assigned
- **Dynamic count wrong** — OData query issue
- **Tile click does nothing** — semantic object action not registered

## Best practices
- **Consistent icons** across similar tiles
- **Meaningful titles** — descriptive not clever
- **Group by process** — how users think
- **KPIs prominent** — most actionable
- **Refresh interval** balanced (not too frequent = perf hit)

title: SAP Fiori: theme customization
body:
## SAP standard themes
- **sap_horizon** (moderno, default)
- **sap_horizon_dark**
- **sap_fiori_3** (Fiori 3 clásico)
- **sap_fiori_3_dark**
- **sap_belize** (older)
- **sap_belize_hcb** (high contrast)

User can switch en launchpad preferences.

## UI Theme Designer
SAP tool para custom themes:
- Web-based (BTP subscription)
- Base on existing theme + modify
- Colors, fonts, logos
- Preview live

URL: `https://<tenant>.themedesigner.hana.ondemand.com`

## Custom theme creation
1. **Theme Designer** → new theme
2. Parent theme: sap_horizon
3. Modify:
   - Primary color
   - Accent colors
   - Header background
   - Logo
   - Font family
4. Save + build
5. Deploy to launchpad

## Config en launchpad
Admin → **Themes** → assign custom theme:
- Default
- Per user group

## CSS overrides (advanced)
Customize specific components con CSS:

### Load custom CSS
manifest.json:
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'resources': {
        'css': [
            { 'uri': 'css/style.css' }
        ]
    }
}
```

### webapp/css/style.css
```css
.myApp .sapMBtn {
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(#4CAF50, #2E7D32);
}
```

## Custom control classes
Add class via view:
```xml
<Button class='myCustomButton' text='Save'/>
```

```css
.myCustomButton {
    background: #ff5722;
    color: white;
}
```

## Corporate branding
Elements to customize:
- Logo (top-left)
- Header background color
- Primary button color
- Font
- Favicon
- Loading animation

## Multi-brand
Multiple themes por tenants:
- Empresa 1: blue theme
- Empresa 2: green theme

Tenant-aware theme selection en launchpad.

## Responsive images
Logo variants for retina displays:
```css
.header-logo {
    background-image: url('logo.png');
}
@media (-webkit-min-device-pixel-ratio: 2) {
    .header-logo {
        background-image: url('logo@2x.png');
    }
}
```

## Accessibility
High contrast themes for vision-impaired users:
- **sap_horizon_hcb** — high contrast black
- **sap_horizon_hcw** — high contrast white

Fonts scalable, keyboard-friendly.

## Compatibility
Custom themes may break with UI5 upgrades:
- Test after each SAP release
- Regenerate themes en Theme Designer

## Preview
```javascript
sap.ui.getCore().applyTheme('sap_horizon_dark');
// Apply theme dynamically
```

Useful for user preference (dark mode toggle).

## Best practices
- **Stay close to SAP defaults** — easier upgrades
- **Test all major screens** after theme change
- **Accessibility maintained**
- **Consistent across apps** in same landscape

title: SAP Fiori: performance optimization
excerpt: Optimizar carga y ejecución de Fiori apps.
body:
## Ver current performance

### Browser DevTools
- Network tab: initial load time
- Performance tab: runtime bottlenecks
- Lighthouse: audit

### UI5 diagnostics
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P → UI5 diagnostics dialog:
- Component load times
- Model updates
- Rendering

## Optimizations

### 1. Async loading
manifest.json:
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'rootView': {
        'viewName': 'com.empresa.miapp.view.App',
        'type': 'XML',
        'async': true
    },
    'routing': {
        'config': {
            'async': true
        }
    }
}
```

Parallel loading of resources.

### 2. Preload files
Bundle multiple files into one `Component-preload.js`:

```bash
npx @ui5/cli build --clean-dest
```

Produces bundled + minified files.

### 3. Lazy loading of views
```javascript
// Only load view when route matched
// Standard routing does this automatically
```

### 4. Optimize OData queries

#### Use $select
```javascript
oModel.read('/Products', {
    urlParameters: {
        '$select': 'ID,Name,Price'  // only fields needed
    }
});
```

#### Server-side paging
```javascript
urlParameters: {
    '$top': 20,
    '$skip': 0
}
```

#### $expand judiciously
Expanding causes JOINs — costly:
```javascript
$expand: 'Category'  // only if needed
```

### 5. Table optimization

#### Growing threshold
```xml
<Table items='{/Products}' growing='true' growingThreshold='50'/>
```

Load 50 at time vs all.

#### Virtual scrolling (sap.ui.table)
For large datasets:
```xml
<t:Table rows='{/Products}' visibleRowCount='20' threshold='100'/>
```

### 6. Cache OData responses
```javascript
var oModel = new sap.ui.model.odata.v2.ODataModel(url, {
    defaultBindingMode: 'OneWay',   // read-only cacheable
    useBatch: true,
    tokenHandling: false            // if no CSRF needed
});
```

### 7. Minimize DOM elements
- Don't render all data at once
- Use table growing (paged)
- Collapse sections users don't view

### 8. Debounce user inputs
Search fields:
```javascript
var timer;
onSearchLiveChange: function(oEvent) {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._doSearch(oEvent.getParameter('newValue'));
    }, 300);
}
```

Avoids call on every keystroke.

### 9. Icon usage
SAP icon fonts loaded once. Prefer icons over images.

### 10. Custom images
- Compress (WebP, PNG optimized)
- Serve via CDN
- Lazy-load below-fold images

## Bundle sizes
Check sizes:
- `Component-preload.js` — should be <500 KB gzipped
- If larger, split into multiple bundles

## Buildpack config
```yaml
# ui5.yaml
specVersion: '3.0'
metadata:
    name: myapp
type: application
builder:
    resources:
        excludes:
            - test/**
            - localService/**
    customTasks:
        - name: ui5-task-minify
```

## Server-side considerations
- HTTP/2 for parallel resource loading
- gzip/brotli compression
- Cache headers (long TTL para static assets)
- CDN (Cloudflare, Akamai)

## Metrics
Monitor:
- Time to first byte (TTFB)
- Time to interactive (TTI)
- Largest contentful paint (LCP)
- Cumulative layout shift (CLS)

## Load test
- 100+ concurrent users
- Realistic scenarios
- Backend + frontend metrics

Tools: JMeter, k6, Gatling.

## Common issues
- **Slow initial load** — bundle not preloaded, or large images
- **Slow table scroll** — no virtual scrolling with large data
- **Perceived slowness** — no busy indicator, user thinks stuck
